name: done-ding
description: Go make coffee: a desktop notification, a chime, and optionally a phone push when a long Claude turn finishes or Claude is waiting on you.

minSeconds.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Only turns at least this long ping you; shorter ones you were watching anyway.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: chime plays a short two-note chime, say speaks a line, none stays quiet.

desktop.title: Desktop notification
desktop.description: Show a desktop notification (osascript on macOS, notify-send on Linux). Off: a toast inside Claude Code.

notifyOnWaiting.title: Ping when Claude waits on you
notifyOnWaiting.description: Also ping when Claude needs a permission or has been waiting for your input.

inHeadless.title: Ping for headless runs
inHeadless.description: Also ping for claude -p and SDK runs, where nobody is at the prompt.

ntfyTopic.title: Phone push: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Get pushes on your phone with the ntfy app: subscribe to a hard-to-guess topic and put it here. Empty: no phone pushes.

ntfyServer.title: Phone push: ntfy server
ntfyServer.description: The ntfy server to publish to (self-hosted works too).
